text:
No fire detections were found on this asset, but I can't confirm that for the whole period.

The search covered 25 September to 25 October 2026 using NASA FIRMS thermal anomaly data from four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS). It found 0 detections intersecting the asset.

However, all four sensors have a gap on the last day, 24 to 25 October. The data for that day was not yet published, or the day was still in progress. Under the run's own rule, every day must be covered by each sensor to count as covered, so the period is not fully covered.

In short: no fires were detected from 25 September to 24 October. Whether a fire occurred on 24-25 October is unknown. Re-running the check once the latest data is published would close that gap.
